**THIS REVISION — PR2b JUDGMENT-DAY REMEDIATION (owner ruling #964, judge forge #963). 3 doc/guard fixes + the tasks.md PR3 lock. Net-parity LOGIC untouched (forged clean by both judges).**

**FIX 1 (REQUIRED — was mis-rated SUGGESTION) — F-1 vacuity guard on the EXPORTED primitives (close the class, not the incident).** `netPresent`, `netAddFull`, and `sign` now each THROW fail-closed on an empty payload signature (`dO`/`dC`/`s` === '') — a documented Error, consistent with `isResolvedAt`'s fail-closed F-1 and `normDiff`'s throw-on-error ethos. Rationale: these are EXPORTED; their contract is for FUTURE direct callers (PR3 is the first new one), so soundness must not depend on how a caller reaches them. `isResolvedAt`'s own F-1 first branch is UNCHANGED (still fires first on the production path; its guard is never reached-through). Each guard has a CONTRACT JSDoc block. **RED→GREEN mutation demonstrated**: removing `netPresent`'s guard reddened test 44 (`# fail 1`); restored → 46/46 GREEN.

**FIX 2 (WARNING real) — removed the cross-file docstring claim.** `isReverterOf` JSDoc no longer asserts "`brain-audit.mjs` never composes it" (a cross-file claim, fragile by construction — PR3 makes it false, documentary-lie family). Rewritten to state only what THIS file guarantees: `isReverterOf` retained because its export + pre-existing test are frozen this PR; `netAddFull` supersedes it as the reverter predicate; PR3 rewrites reverter-skip onto `netAddFull` and removes `isReverterOf`.

**FIX 3 (SUGGESTION) — corrected "kept BYTE-FOR-BYTE" wording** in `isResolvedAt`'s F-1 JSDoc → literal truth: return object + reason string preserved and it remains the FIRST branch, but the condition variable was renamed `pO` → `dO`.

**FIX 4 (THE LOCK — governance lives in the repo, not memory) — wrote the PR3 hard gate into `tasks.md`.** New **Phase 3.0 — HARD GATE (BLOCKING — PR3 CANNOT SHIP WITHOUT THIS)** inserted after PR3's DEFERRED REWORK NOTE, before Phase 3.1. Two blocking tasks: (3.0.1) rewrite `reverterSkipLine` from direction-blind `isReverterOf` → directional full-window `netAddFull` (exempt ⟺ `dC ≠ '' AND netAddFull ≤ 0`, `TREE_KEYED_CHECKS`-restricted), delete `isReverterOf`/`isOffender` enumeration + add no-import drift-guard; RED proof = diffSize-shaped A7 end-to-end fixture in `brain-audit.test.mjs` (`O` adds >400-line file, `R=revert -m1 O`, `R2=revert -m1 R`; at HEAD=R2 audit MUST NOT emit all-`[SKIP]`/exit 0), mutation bar = MUST redden against current `isReverterOf`-based `reverterSkipLine` (Judge A forged this, #963). (3.0.2) fix A6 test's lying title "closes the revert-of-revert loop" (only tests O+R+claim) — extend to real O,R,R2 or retitle honestly. Callout SUPERSEDES the invalid `isReverterOf` wiring in Phase 3.2.6. All owner prose preserved — surgical additive edit.

**Where**: `brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs` (fixes 1–3), `brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.test.mjs` (fix 1's 3 export-vacuity tests appended at line 986, BELOW the frozen finder block 747–890 which is byte-identical/untouched), `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/tasks.md` (fix 4 Phase 3.0 gate + marked 2b.7.4/2b.7.6 done). NOT touched: `brain-audit.mjs` (PR3's own work), net-parity logic.

FROZEN block (747–890) byte-identical (new section starts line 986). resolution.mjs budget: **+185/−38 = 223 counted** vs `feature/v2.0.0` (~56% of 400, no `size:exception`).
